note: Team-maintained source of truth for scorer caveats, tracked in git. Keyed by scorer TYPE so combined profiles inherit caveats automatically. 'caveats' are endpoint-conditional curated knowledge; 'requirements' are checked live against the EPP Deployment when cluster access is available (unavailable cluster access reports unknown, never missing). Re-verify after router upgrades and edit this file.

caveats.reason: Router token estimator cannot process /v1/audio/speech request bodies, so the predictor receives no training data (re-verified against v0.11.0, v1.0.0 and main on 2026-10-22; a fix, PR #3712, merged to main on 2026-11-02 but is not in a release and is unverified on a deployment).

Prompt-text token estimation for image-generation requests merged upstream (llm-d-router PR #3721) but is not in v0.11.0/v1.0.0 and has not been verified on any deployed image; predictor behavior for image workloads is therefore unverified and depends on the deployed router version.

Prompt-text estimation for image edits merged upstream (PR #3721) but is version-dependent and unverified; it also excludes the reference-image input and output-generation cost (issue #3720), so the estimate covers only the text prompt and predictor behavior is unverified.
Token estimator gap: no usable prefix-match data for TTS prompts, so cache reuse cannot be compared.

Prompt-text estimation for image generation merged upstream (PR #3721) but is version-dependent and unverified on a deployment; estimated prompt tokens do not match engine KV blocks, so cache-aware routing quality is unverified.

Prompt-text estimation for image edits merged upstream (PR #3721) but is version-dependent and unverified, and the reference-image input is excluded from the estimate (issue #3720); cache-aware routing quality for edits is unverified.
TTS tokenization fails, so the input length reads as zero and length-based decisions are meaningless.

Input-length estimation for image generation merged upstream (PR #3721) but is version-dependent and unverified; it also excludes output-generation cost (image size, inference steps — issue #3720), so length-based decisions may not reflect real request cost.

Input-length estimation for image edits merged upstream (PR #3721) but is version-dependent and unverified; it excludes the reference-image input and output-generation cost (issue #3720), so length-based decisions may not reflect real request cost.
Missing TTS input-token estimate makes the token-load comparison across pods unreliable.

Prompt-text estimation for image generation merged upstream (PR #3721) but is version-dependent and unverified; a prompt-only estimate also excludes output-generation cost (issue #3720), so token-load comparisons may not reflect real load.

Prompt-text estimation for image edits merged upstream (PR #3721) but is version-dependent and unverified, and it excludes the reference-image input and output-generation cost (issue #3720), so token-load comparisons may not reflect real load.
Without prefix data every request is treated as cold: this exercises LRU spreading only, not cache-aware routing.
Prefix data for image generation is unverified on current deployments. If prefix data is missing, requests are treated as cold and this exercises LRU spreading only.
Prefix data for image edits is unverified on current deployments. If prefix data is missing, requests are treated as cold and this exercises LRU spreading only.
Text-input TTS produces audio but supplies no multimodal input media, so there are no embeddings to reuse.
Image-generation requests take a text prompt and supply no multimodal input media, so there are no input embeddings to reuse (structural, not version-dependent).

Edits supply an input image, but in the local (older) router checkout the parser skips uploaded file parts, so the scorer may never see the reference image; verify the deployed router version before concluding whether this scorer has a usable signal for edits.
Applies fixed label-based preferences only, and both current TTS pods share the same baseline-model label, so it cannot distinguish them.
Reads stage-0 KV usage only, which may not reflect whole-pipeline load; treat results as exploratory.
Reads stage-0 KV usage; diffusion-based image generation may not use KV cache the same way as autoregressive models, so treat results as exploratory.
Reads stage-0 KV usage; diffusion-based image editing may not use KV cache the same way as autoregressive models, so treat results as exploratory.
